environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on EC2 c5.xlarge instance running Amazon Linux 2. The Actix-web service is compiled with `cargo build --release` (no debug assertions, no overflow checks in release mode). Service runs directly on port 8080 behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) configured in TCP passthrough mode with no additional rules. No WAF, no API Gateway, no rate limiting. The service binary has ASLR but no stack canaries (compiled with `-C overflow-checks=no -C panic=abort`). Security groups allow inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.
